request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a high-medieval kingdom around the year 1250. Buildings are made of pale grey-beige stone, cream plaster with dark oak timber framing, oak planks and calm dusty terracotta-red roof tiles (a muted brick red, never bright red); every colour is muted and a little pale, each material shaded with one slightly darker tone of its own colour.
layers.negative: gun, musket, rifle, pistol, cannon, gunpowder, top hat, bicorne, tricorne, Napoleonic uniform, modern clothing, magic glow, glowing runes, wings, flag, banner, pennant, heraldry, bright red, neon, saturated colours, people, soldier, person, character

layers.text: Class: one single building or improvement map piece with a unique chunky silhouette, a soft dark-brown outline (never black), big simple shapes and fewer details than a unit, calmer and paler than a unit. It stands directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under it; the bottom of the building is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, people, crowd, second building

layers.text: Subject: a windmill: one round tower of cream plaster on a pale stone footing with a small oak door, a dusty terracotta cone roof, and four big sail arms of oak lattice with plain cream canvas, set in a big X on the front and wider than the tower; no fence, no field. Buildings only.
